title: Attachment Styles Assessment
description: Discover your attachment style in relationships

questions.question: How do you typically feel in close relationships?

options.text: I feel comfortable being close to others and depending on them
I want to be close but worry that others don't value the relationship as much
I prefer to maintain my independence and not rely on others too much
My feelings about closeness change frequently

questions.question: When conflicts arise in relationships, I usually:

options.text: Discuss issues openly and work toward resolution
Worry the conflict means the relationship is ending
Withdraw and need space to process alone
Feel confused about how to respond

questions.question: My view of relationships is generally:

options.text: Positive and trusting - relationships can be secure and fulfilling
I want closeness but often fear abandonment or rejection
I value independence more than emotional intimacy
I want closeness but also fear it

secure.title: Secure Attachment
secure.description: You have a secure attachment style. You're comfortable with intimacy and independence, and you generally trust others and feel confident in relationships.
traits: Good at balancing independence and closeness

anxious.title: Anxious Attachment
anxious.description: You have an anxious attachment style. You may seek high levels of intimacy and approval, and sometimes worry about your partner's commitment or availability.
traits: Sensitive to partner's moods and behaviors

avoidant.title: Avoidant Attachment
avoidant.description: You have an avoidant attachment style. You value independence highly and may feel uncomfortable with too much emotional intimacy or dependence.
traits: May feel uncomfortable with too much closeness
May prioritize work or hobbies over relationships

disorganized.title: Disorganized Attachment
disorganized.description: You have a disorganized attachment style. You may experience conflicting desires for closeness and independence, sometimes sending mixed signals to partners.
traits: May have unpredictable responses to intimacy
May benefit from therapy to develop secure patterns
